verdict.rationale: Yubico runs public developer documentation portals, so whether that documentation is agent-consumable is a fair question for this product. The evidence shows it is not: llms.txt returns HTTP 404 on docs.yubico.com, developers.yubico.com and www.yubico.com. Appending .md to pages yields no markdown, and the docs are described as human-oriented HTML only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
